items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-11-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] We're still looking at Rick. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, it's not like somebody else. One reason or another.

ctx.x: All right. Seems like we're better. Let me see the list. We're still looking at Rick. We're looking at, let me see if I can find, look at the, oh, yeah, Rex. Okay. Let's see who else. So you didn't know who Ty Robin was? No, no, no. Okay. The one song. Can you see a face? No. No, you don't even see a face. Okay. Of course, Chuck Carbo. Ty, wherever you are. Ty, I'm sorry. Jerry McCann, she's tough. And he, you don't remember him? He was a, I know he was a blues singer. Yeah, I don't know. I think from Mississippi.
Yeah, it's not like somebody else. One reason or another.
